def run_migrations_offline() -> None:


    """Run migrations offline."""
    # pylint: disable-next=no-member
    context.configure(
        url=database_url(),
        target_metadata=Base.metadata,
        literal_binds=True,
        dialect_opts={"paramstyle": "named"},
    )
    # pylint: disable-next=no-member
    with context.begin_transaction():
        # pylint: disable-next=no-member
        context.run_migrations()


def run_migrations_online() -> None:


    """Run migrations online."""
    engine = create_engine(database_url(), pool_pre_ping=True)
    try:
        with engine.connect() as connection:
            # pylint: disable-next=no-member
            context.configure(connection=connection, target_metadata=Base.metadata)
            # pylint: disable-next=no-member
            with context.begin_transaction():
                # pylint: disable-next=no-member
                context.run_migrations()
    finally:
        engine.dispose()


# pylint: disable-next=no-member
if context.is_offline_mode():

Run uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v.

## Authentication

Set JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_FILE, JWT_ISSUER and JWT_AUDIENCE. Use an RS256 token with sub, iat, exp, iss, aud, and role=editor for writes. Public RSA keys must have at least 2048 bits.

## Authentication

Set FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID. Use Firebase bearer tokens. Set the trusted custom role claim to editor for writes. Revoked or disabled users are rejected. Local tests may set APP_ENV=test and FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST to a loopback mock.

## Authentication

Set GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI, GOOGLE_EDITOR_SUBJECTS (JSON subject list), REDIS_URL and REDIS_NAMESPACE. Use /auth/google/login. Sessions and one-use login state live in Redis. Use the csrf value from /auth/me as X-CSRF-Token for writes. POST /auth/logout ends the session. Outside tests, HTTPS is required. Only local tests may use SOM_TEST_OIDC_ISSUER with APP_ENV=test.

## Objects

This app has no object store.
PUT, GET and DELETE /objects/{key} accept safe keys of 1 to 80 characters. Objects are at most 1 MiB. PUT returns SHA-256. A same-body retry is safe. A different body with the same key returns 409. Object writes and database writes are separate operations.

## Objects

Set S3_BUCKET and AWS credentials through the SDK environment or credential chain. Local tests may set SOM_TEST_S3_ENDPOINT with APP_ENV=test.
PUT, GET and DELETE /objects/{key} accept safe keys of 1 to 80 characters. Objects are at most 1 MiB. PUT returns SHA-256. A same-body retry is safe. A different body with the same key returns 409. Object writes and database writes are separate operations.

## Objects

Set GCS_BUCKET and GCS_PROJECT. Use Google application default credentials. Local tests may set STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST with APP_ENV=test.
PUT, GET and DELETE /objects/{key} accept safe keys of 1 to 80 characters. Objects are at most 1 MiB. PUT returns SHA-256. A same-body retry is safe. A different body with the same key returns 409. Object writes and database writes are separate operations.

## Workflow

GET <parent-path>/{parent_id}/export processes up to 1000 children in ID order. The workflow is json_export. Larger results return 413. CSV apps also accept POST <parent-path>/{parent_id}/import with text/csv and 1 to 20 rows. Headers must match custom child fields. \N means null. CSV import commits once or rolls back all rows.

type JsonValue = bool | int | float | str | list[JsonValue] | dict[str, JsonValue] | None
type JsonObject = dict[str, JsonValue]
type FieldValue = str | int | float | bool | date | None
JSON_OBJECT: TypeAdapter[JsonObject] = TypeAdapter(JsonObject)
FIELD_VALUES: TypeAdapter[dict[str, FieldValue]] = TypeAdapter(dict[str, FieldValue])


def json_object(value: object) -> JsonObject:


    """Json object."""
    return JSON_OBJECT.validate_python(value)


def model_values(model: BaseModel, *, exclude_unset: bool = False) -> dict[str, FieldValue]:


    """Model values."""
    return FIELD_VALUES.validate_python(model.model_dump(exclude_unset=exclude_unset), strict=True)


class Counter(TypedDict):

def create_router(_session_provider: Callable[[], None]) -> APIRouter:
    """Create router."""
    router = APIRouter(dependencies=[Depends(require_access)])

    def _encode(values: Mapping[str, FieldValue]) -> dict[str, object]:

        """ encode."""
        return {key: datetime.combine(value, time(), UTC) if isinstance(value, date) and not isinstance(value, datetime) else value for key, value in values.items()}

    async def transaction[T](callback: Callable[[AsyncClientSession], Awaitable[T]]) -> T:

        """Transaction[t]."""
        try:
            async with client.start_session() as session:
                return await session.with_transaction(callback)
        except DuplicateKeyError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="unique value conflict") from exc
        except PyMongoError as exc:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail="database unavailable") from exc

    async def require_parent(parent_id: int, session: AsyncClientSession | None = None, touch: bool = False) -> Parent:

        """Require parent."""
        row: Parent | None
        if touch:
            raw = await Parent.get_pymongo_collection().find_one_and_update({"_id": parent_id}, {"$inc": {"_som_revision": 1}}, session=session)
            row = Parent.model_validate(raw) if raw is not None else None
        else:
            row = await Parent.find_one(Parent.id == parent_id, session=session)
        if row is None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="parent not found")
        return row

    async def _require_child(parent_id: int, child_id: int, session: AsyncClientSession | None = None) -> Child:

        """ require child."""
        await require_parent(parent_id, session)
        row = await Child.find_one(Child.id == child_id, Child.{{foreign_key}} == parent_id, session=session)
        if row is None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="child not found")
        return row

    async def insert[T: MongoDocument](model: type[T], values: Mapping[str, object], session: AsyncClientSession) -> T:

        """Insert[t: mongodocument]."""
        # Both the counter and new document are part of the same transaction.
        raw_counter = await database["_som_counters"].find_one_and_update({"_id": model.get_settings().name}, {"$inc": {"value": 1}}, upsert=True, return_document=ReturnDocument.AFTER, session=session)
        counter = TypeAdapter(Counter).validate_python(raw_counter, strict=True)
        now = datetime.now(UTC)
        # BSON stores millisecond precision. Return the same timestamp that a
        # later read will return, including the immediate POST response.
        now = now.replace(microsecond=(now.microsecond // 1000) * 1000)
        adapter: TypeAdapter[T] = TypeAdapter(model)
        row = adapter.validate_python({"_id": counter["value"], "created_at": now, "updated_at": now, **values})
        await row.insert(session=session)
        return row


    async def workflow_rows(parent_id: int) -> list[JsonObject]:


        """Workflow rows."""
        await require_parent(parent_id)
        rows = await Child.find(Child.{{foreign_key}} == parent_id).sort("_id").limit(1001).to_list()
        if len(rows) > 1000:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=413, detail="workflow is limited to 1000 rows")
        return [json_object(ChildRead.model_validate(row).model_dump(mode="json")) for row in rows]

    async def _workflow_import(parent_id: int, records: list[ChildCreate]) -> list[JsonObject]:

        """ workflow import."""
        async def write(session: AsyncClientSession) -> list[JsonObject]:
            """Write."""
            await require_parent(parent_id, session, touch=True)
            return [json_object(ChildRead.model_validate(await insert(Child, {"{{foreign_key}}": parent_id, **model_values(data)}, session)).model_dump(mode="json")) for data in records]
        return await transaction(write)

@router.delete({{path}}, status_code=204)
    async def delete_parent(parent_id: int) -> Response:
        """Delete parent."""
        async def write(session: AsyncClientSession) -> None:
            """Write."""
            row = await require_parent(parent_id, session)
            await require_parent(parent_id, session, touch=True)
            if await Child.find_one(Child.{{foreign_key}} == parent_id, session=session):
                raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="parent has children")
            await row.delete(session=session)
        await transaction(write)
        return Response(status_code=204)

@router.delete({{path}}, status_code=204)
    async def delete_child(parent_id: int, child_id: int) -> Response:
        """Delete child."""
        async def write(session: AsyncClientSession) -> None:
            """Write."""
            row = await _require_child(parent_id, child_id, session)
            await row.delete(session=session)
        await transaction(write)
        return Response(status_code=204)
